title: Twist E26: Frobenius blocks, hybrid elimination and bounded invariant encodings
status_note: Partial local evidence, 2026-10-23; full experiment blocked and unfunded. Four requested block-elimination candidates remain unimplemented and unrun. E30 incidence pilot is a separate encoding experiment and does not replace this requirement. Complete raw publication awaits artifact-store credentials.
blocked_on: note:Four requested block-elimination candidates remain unimplemented and unrun. E30 incidence pilot is a separate encoding experiment and does not replace this requirement.
question: Can splitting rational/anti-rational variable blocks or eliminating a small helper block reduce certified solver work on the same projected relation task?
decision_value: A verified heldout stage gain can proceed to a complete pipeline comparison under E27. Otherwise record a loss, tie or incomplete cell for each frozen encoding; no coordinate reformulation is automatically called an advance.

resources.notes: Proposed pilot: one CPU, 4 GiB, 30 seconds per solver cell; cap helper enumeration at eight values and at most four encodings. All branch solves are charged to the same candidate cell. Full resources remain unestimated. The nominal disk field is not an estimate; calibrate and freeze it before readiness.
